message.content:
When it comes to jazz singing, several artists stand out as some of the best and most influential. While “best” can be subjective and depends on personal taste, here’s a list of widely recognized jazz vocalists who have made significant contributions to the genre:

| Artist | Notable Works | Why They’re Considered Great |
|--------|---------------|------------------------------|
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | *“Dream a Little Dream of Me,” “Summertime”* | Known as the “First Lady of Song,” her impeccable diction, scat singing, and pure tone set a high standard for jazz vocalists. |
| **Billie Holiday** | *“Strange Fruit,” “God Bless the Child”* | Her emotive phrasing and unique voice brought depth and vulnerability to jazz standards. |
| **Sarah Vaughan** | *“Misty,” “Lullaby of Birdland”* | With a wide vocal range and rich timbre, she blended jazz with classical influences. |
| **Nat King Cole** | *“Unforgettable,” “Mona Lisa”* | His smooth baritone and relaxed delivery made him a crossover star while staying true to jazz roots. |
| **Nina Simone** | *“Feeling Good,” “I Put a Spell on You”* | A blend of jazz, blues, and soul, her powerful voice carried strong social messages. |
| **Cassandra Wilson** | *“The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face”* | Modern jazz vocalist known for her deep, husky voice and innovative interpretations. |
| **Diana Krall** | *“The Look of Love”* | Contemporary jazz pianist and singer with a warm, intimate style. |
| **Tony Bennett** | *“I Left My Heart in San Francisco”* | Classic crooner with a timeless approach to jazz standards. |
| **Michael Bublé** | *“Feeling Good”* | Modern pop-jazz crossover artist with a polished, nostalgic sound. |
| **Esperanza Spalding** | *“I Know You Know”* | Bassist and vocalist blending jazz with funk, soul, and world music. |

These artists represent different eras and styles within jazz, each bringing their own unique voice and interpretation to the genre. If you’re looking for a particular era or style, let me know, and I can narrow down the recommendations further!
